fact: Graphic Online reports that the Minister of Education launched the Ghana Education Service Management Information System (GESMIS) in Accra in December 2024, a home-grown Ghana Education Service platform meant to consolidate the service's data, with an online results checking system for students and the stated purpose of tracking student performance and monitoring teacher attendance; the article does not say whether schools enter a record per learner, at which levels, or in how many schools.
title: Education Minister launches GES digital platform - Move to improve access, transparency, equity
